The Role
Join Kyndryl as an Application Consultant and become a catalyst for innovation and transformation. In this role, you'll be at the forefront of driving change and enabling our customers to harness the power of technology to achieve their wildest ambitions. From revolutionizing healthcare to shaping the future of finance, you'll collaborate with a diverse range of industries, tailoring cutting-edge solutions to meet each customer's unique needs.
As a trusted advisor, you'll forge strong relationships with our customers, gaining deep insights into their business objectives and long-term aspirations. Armed with this understanding, you'll provide expert guidance on how technology can be leveraged to propel them towards unprecedented success. From aligning processes to technology to developing and deploying bespoke solutions, you'll be the visionary architect behind their digital transformation journey. Your expertise in application development and deployment best practices will ensure seamless integration and optimized performance.
In this role, your impact will be immense. You'll conduct thorough needs assessments, uncovering the requirements for new applications or upgrades to existing ones, and document these specifications with utmost precision using cutting-edge Business Analysis (BA) methodologies. Whether it's crafting comprehensive use cases, tracing requirements meticulously, or visualizing process flows, your attention to detail will be unmatched.
Drawing upon your exceptional analytical prowess, you'll gather requirements from stakeholders and masterfully translate them into functional and nonfunctional specifications. As the driving force behind our customers' application modernization endeavors, you'll guide them through every step of the process, ensuring their systems are future-proofed and optimized for success. Your expertise will also come into play as you assist customers in selecting and customizing the perfect packaged solutions to fulfill their unique business needs.
Collaboration will be your cornerstone as you work closely with application architects and development staff to bring your visions to life. Your keen eye for detail will shine as you analyze requirements, meticulously plan design and implementation work, all while adhering to time, cost, and quality targets. You'll consult with customers on compatibility challenges, such as hardware and operating system considerations, data conversion processes, and training requirements, offering them holistic solutions that align seamlessly with their budgets.
In this fast-paced environment, you'll have the exhilarating responsibility of helping customers choose between multiple applications, including packaged solutions. Your sharp insights and discerning judgement will empower them to make informed decisions that drive their organizations towards unprecedented heights.
Our consultants are restless for innovation. They are at the edge of technology, changing the way our customers implement business solutions – so, if you’re a problem-solver, an innovative thinker, and a self-starter with a passion high impact assignments which align technology to business outcomes, then we want to hear from you! Apply today to join our dynamic team that has a host of exciting projects and customers waiting for you to work with them to solve complex transformation puzzles through technology.

As an Application Consultant at Kyndryl you will join the Kyndryl Consultant Profession, working with other Kyndryl Consultants, Architects, Project Managers, and cross-functional Technical Subject Matter Experts – presenting unlimited opportunities with unmatched support through our investment in your learning, training, and career growth.
Who You Are
You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
Required Skills And Experience

  • Experience in mainframe application development and modernization.
  • Proven experience in designing and implementing modernization strategies for mainframe applications.
  • Prior hands-on experience working in a Mainframe environment.
  • Expertise in mainframe technologies, architectures, and programming languages such as COBOL, PL/I, and Java.
  • Strong understanding of z/OS and IBM Software Products as well as 3rd party Mainframe software.
  • Experience with AWS Mainframe Modernization service, Azure Skytap, Arcad Software suite, and/or other cloud-native services.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

  • Hands on keyboard, Sales support, Systematics knowledge, API development, Integration architecture, Mainframe and Cloud development experience, Working knowledge of infrastructure.
  • Advanced english level.
Preferred Skills And Experience
  • AWS certification or equivalent cloud certification.
  • Experience with modernization technologies from Micro Focus, Astadia, Bluage, Cast, or RainCode.
  • Knowledge of mainframe security practices and associated tools.
Being You
Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.
What You Can Expect
With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

Job Description

Posted Thursday, July 24, 2025 at 5:00 AM | Expires Thursday, August 7, 2025 at 4:59 AM

At Sylvamo, we’re a team on a mission. Joining us, you’ll be helping to sustain forests and renew ecosystems, while delivering on the promise of paper to educate, communicate and entertain the world.

Come grow with us!

Supply Chain & Manufacturing Application Services - IT Business Consultant

Purpose:

Sylvamo’s IT Enterprise Application Services organization is responsible for designing, building, implementing and sustaining an Enterprise Supply Chain solution. The objective of the solution is to support and enable changing business processes to improve customer satisfaction and reduce supply chain costs. Enterprise Application Services includes Commercial Excellence, Finance & Sourcing, Supply Chain & Manufacturing, HR & EHS, and Application Development.

The Supply Chain and Manufacturing Application Services IT Business Consultant will work in a lean team environment to recommend and deliver technology enabling business processes in SAP covering Supply Chain (Supply Chain Planning and Order to Invoice processes) and our Manufacturing Execution System) along with a number of 3rd party integrations.

The applications in scope include SAP APO, ECC, BW and our MES applications. There are 3rd party applications in scope that will be managed and supported including Loftware, Load Xpert that will require helping manage vendor relations supporting enhancements, projects, deployments, documentation maintenance, integration changes, data extractions, application licenses, and in some cases 1st and 2nd level application support.

The team provides business, operational and technical expertise for IT solutions including design and implementation of Supply Chain and Manufacturing solutions that could consist of in-house and 3rd party applications.

IT point of contact and consults for custom features within vendor products, and acts as a liaison working across IT, the business and with our Managed Service partners.

The candidate should have configuration experience and knowledge of Supply Chain and Manufacturing processes with functional and configuration knowledge of SAP APO DP/S&OP/PPDS, SAP ECC SD/PP/CO/PM and how to integrate with 3rd party applications to support functional and process changes to enable business requirements.

The candidate needs leadership skills to organize, facilitate, and lead design, build and testing activities supporting enhancements and projects as well as to be a point of contact for vendors supporting 3rd party applications.

The candidate will need leadership skills to manage work with our Managed Service Partners.

ERM is looking for a Senior Biodiversity Consultant in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte, Porto Alegre or Salvador.
Key responsabilities:

  • Lead biodiversity baseline studies, critical habitat assessments, and ecosystem services evaluations to inform project planning and conservation strategies.
  • Lead vegetation suppression processes, from field to reports elaboration;
  • Identify and assess project-related risks and impacts on species, habitats, and ecosystem functions, applying the mitigation hierarchy to avoid, minimize, and restore biodiversity loss.
  • Prepare technical documentation, including biotic environmental sections of Environmental and Social Impact Assessments (ESIAs), and compliance reports for regulators and financial institutions.
  • Ensure alignment with IFC Performance Standard 6 (PS6), IUCN guidelines, Business and Biodiversity Offsets Programme (BBOP) principles, and relevant national regulations.
  • Develop and implement Biodiversity Action Plans (BAPs), including offset strategies where necessary, to achieve measurable conservation outcomes.
  • Design and oversee biodiversity monitoring programs, including Key Biodiversity Indicators (KBIs), to track ecological performance and inform adaptive management.
  • Integrate nature-related risks, dependencies, and opportunities into project decision-making and reporting, in line with the Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures (TNFD) framework.
Qualifications & Experience:
  • Degree in Biology, Ecology, or a related field.
  • At least 8 years of experience in biodiversity assessment, management, and conservation planning.
  • Demonstrated expertise in applying IFC Performance Standard 6 (including Critical Habitat Assessments, Biodiversity Action Plans and biodiversity offsets) and integrating nature-related risk frameworks such as TNFD.
  • Proficient in GIS, remote sensing, and biodiversity data platforms (e.g., IBAT, STAR, IUCN Red List).
  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, with excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Experience working in biodiversity-sensitive regions is highly desirable.
  • Excellent writing skills in both Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to remain composed under pressure and adapt to the dynamic nature of consultancy work.
  • Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel as required.
ABOUT ERM:
Environmental Resources Management (ERM) is a leading global provider of environmental, health, safety, risk, social consulting services and sustainability related services. We have more than 160 offices in over 40 countries and territories employing more than 8,000 people who work on projects around the world. ERM is committed to providing a service that is consistent, professional and of the highest quality to create value for our clients. We have worked with many of the Global Fortune 500 companies delivering innovative solutions for business and selected government clients helping them understand and manage the sustainability challenges that the world is increasingly facing.
For over 50 years we have been working with clients around the world and in diverse industry sectors to help them to understand and manage their environmental, health, safety, risk and social impacts. The key sectors we serve include Oil & Gas, Mining, Power, and Manufacturing, Chemical and Pharmaceutical. All face critical sustainability challenges and our clients in these and many other areas rely on our ability to assist them operate more sustainably which has a positive impact on our planet.
At ERM we know that creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment is an essential part of making our company a great place to build a career.
If you would like to read more about Diversity, Equality, Inclusion and Belonging
 (DEIB) at ERM, you can visit our website , or read about our progress in the 2024 Sustainability Report .

You will have responsibility for end-to-end business ownership of the import supply chain processes from manufacturer to the availability in our Fulfillment Centers and for developing and implementing inventory management strategies to optimize customer experience.
The position requires an individual who can work autonomously in a fast paced, demanding and often ambiguous environment. Additionally since this position involves working with multiple teams and partners in a fast growing opportunity, the role requires strong stakeholder management capabilities and ownership with great bias for action in getting things done themselves. In this role, you will be a true entrepreneur, exercising your commercial acumen and managing all aspects of your business on a daily basis.
Key job responsibilities

  • Educate and onboard vendors to Amazon Direct Imports.
  • Build and maintain relationships with Senior leaders, Finance, Retail and partners to grow and optimize the joint import business.
  • Develop and improve vendor relations and import sourcing for cost savings and new selection.
  • Work with key stakeholders around the world to maintain alignment.
  • Drive integration between new vendors and Amazon supply chain, product compliance and merchandising processes.
  • Contribute to the development of best practices and contract standards.
  • Monitor, analyze and own key performance indicators such as vendor import share, out of stock rate, vendor operational metrics, marketing investments.
  • Work with vendors and Amazon operations to ensure a reliable, operational a cost effective flow of goods, from ordering to receive.
  • Work with internal teams to understand the systems and variables that affect purchasing and vendor management decisions.
  • Lead projects and regular business improvement initiatives.
A day in the life
Retail Managers are owners of the Retail business. Either for subcategories or subgroup of vendors they own the respective business end-to-end including the entire P&L, from topline down to free cash flow. They manage inputs by driving selection, securing great prices and increasing convenience/speed to accelerate Amazon’s flywheel. While they focus their activities on our most strategically relevant vendors and holdouts, they audit and escalate the performance of lower tiered vendors.

title: MEDICO DO TRABALHO
description:
Horário: 2º turno
Modalidade: Presencial
Descrição:

  1. Colaborar com os Supervisores de Saúde ocupacional local (no site) na aplicação das diretrizes técnicas e protocolos para os programas de atenção à saúde do trabalhador, atuando diretamente na execução dos programas, estimulando ações preventivas de saúde e cumprindo as determinações Legais;
  2. Participar da elaboração/ coordenação e análise crítica de documentos bases, que incluem o Programa de Gerenciamento de Riscos (PGR), Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional (PCMSO), Programa de Conservação Auditiva (PCA) e Programa de Controle dos Riscos Ergonômicos (PCRE);
  3. Realizar exames clínicos ocupacionais (admissionais, periódicos, mudança de função, retorno ao trabalho e demissionais), de acordo com a Legislação vigente (NR7) e as diretrizes do Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional;
  4. Lançar resultados e observações clínicas em prontuário médico ocupacional em sistema de informática;
  5. Suportar tecnicamente a secretaria da saúde ocupacional nos processos de absenteísmo, desde a coleta de dados do afastamento até sua análise e propostas de melhoria;
  6. Gerenciar afastamentos previdenciários;
  7. Suportar o jurídico trabalhista nas análises e argumentação médica para processos judiciais e contestações B91 ( Previdenciárias);
  8. Realizar as atividades e dar andamento nos processos de afastamentos do trabalho, trabalho modificado, reabilitação profissional, readaptação de desaposentados e reintegração judicial;
  9. Classificar lesões decorrentes de acidentes de trabalho de qualquer natureza e acompanhar clinicamente o empregado especificando suas limitações, avaliando atividades compatíveis, se houver;
  10. Realizar exames admissionais em pessoas com deficiência (PCD), especificando seu enquadramento na Legal, suas limitações e homologar atividade compatível. Garantir a qualidade dos dados e registros de todos os serviços prestados possibilitando relatórios estatísticos e epidemiológicos, que atendam à legislação trabalhista;
  11. Emitir laudos, pareceres e relatórios que possam garantir a segurança jurídica da empresa (civil e trabalhista);
  12. Garantir a qualidade dos serviços prestados, reportando dados para subsidiar análises estatísticas e epidemiológicas que suportem ações de promoção de Saúde, visando atender à legislação trabalhista, previdenciária e normas de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente;
  13. Dar suporte técnico à equipe de Saúde Ocupacional do site, sendo referência para os processos de complexidade 3 e 4 em Medicina do Trabalho (afastamentos do trabalho, trabalho modificado, reabilitação profissional, readaptação de desaposentados, reintegração judicial, classificação de acidentes de trabalho, suporte jurídico a reclamatórias trabalhistas e avaliação de impactos dos riscos ergonômicos à saúde do trabalhador), interagindo e orientando as equipes operacionais, garantindo a qualidade dos registros e relatórios estatísticos e epidemiológicos.

Requisitos:
  • Superior Completo em Medicina com Pós Graduação em Medicina do Trabalho;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Nível intermediário em Pacote Office;
  • Conhecimento na realização de exames ocupacionais (admissionais, periódicos, mudança de risco, retorno ao trabalho, demissionais);
  • Conhecimento em softwares ocupacionais (SOC, Senior, Totus, entre outros);
  • Conhecimento em Coordenação de PCMSO;
  • Conhecimento em implantação de Programas de Qualidade de Vida.

title: Performance Supervisor
description:
Select how often (in days) to receive an alert:

The Performance Supervisor is responsible of optimizing and overseeing the discharge of duties and functions of the performance engineering team on power plant performance analysis, operational efficiency monitoring, asset management, geothermal resource management and quality improvement. The position initiates intensive operational data analysis, power plant performance improvement alternatives and provides technical guidance for the implementation of viable options to optimize power plant operation, generation losses recovery and key performance indicators analysis.

Power Plant Performance Improvement and Optimization

  • Supervises the development of statistical trend analyses of geothermal resource data and plant operational parameters that identifies variances critical to plant efficiency and creation of recommendation using data analytics to close the gaps based on baseline data.
  • Creates short- and long-term generation and key performance indicators forecasts and models in relation to current assumptions and status of geothermal resource, future power plant and steam field plans, activities and initiatives to support business objectives and strategies.
  • Supervises the analysis of affected plant systems and/or sub-systems during incidents with reliability losses, as it occurs and after the generating unit is restored; and for the pro-active development and implementation of quality improvement counter-measures in collaboration with plant production and maintenance team.
  • Ensures accuracy of performance reports (e.g., generation losses report, generation efficiency report, generation rolling forecast, geo performance monitoring report) and monitors/evaluates plant key performance indicators in support of creating operational strategies to achieve business objectives and targets.
  • Determines and regularly updates the geothermal steam and/or brine availability and/or decline resource priority allocation to operating units, level of MW dispatch, and standby reserve generating unit capacity, all to optimize electricity production availability, improve steam rate / thermal efficiency and reduce specific operating cost electricity production.
  • As needed, conducts research and business cases in technical collaboration with power plant production and maintenance team, steam field facility operator and/or industry technical solution providers/research firms to provide commercially viable and timely solutions that enable geothermal resource optimization, while minimizing risk of malfunction of geothermal surface facilities and mitigates the losses associated with geothermal fluid decline.

Fuel Management through Geothermal Resources Supply and Services Agreement (GRSSA)

  • Monitors and evaluates geothermal fluid supply quantity and quality from agreed GRSSA specifications and the initiation of appropriate remedies for quality deviations;
  • Conducts monthly meter reading report review in coordination with steam supplier (PGPC) to validate generation data and determine/settle data variances.
  • Ensures, in collaboration with preventive maintenance teams, that instruments, meters and data recorders for steam supply and electricity production meets accuracy requirements for GRSSA and endorses, monthly meter reading for approval and payment on the basis all requirements are satisfactorily complied with;
  • Determines Field Rated Capacity of the prevailing steam supply in coordination with the steam field facility operator, Philippine Geothermal Production Company Inc. (PGPC), with all generating units simultaneously operating at optimum capacity.

Asset Management Policies and Guidelines

  • Adopts and implements Asset Management policies and guidelines in alignment with AP guidelines.
  • Conducts audits of Asset Management policy and compliance to standards. Ensures preventive actions are taken on a timely manner and ensures review is done regularly and policies and procedures are updated as necessary.

Administrative Reports and Functions

  • Provides direction and oversight to the activities of the Performance Engineering group.
  • Ensures review is done regularly and policies and procedures are updated as necessary
  • Performs other related tasks and/or functions that may be assigned by Asset Manager

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Must be a graduate of a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
  • Must be a Registered Mechanical Engineer or Registered Electrical Engineer
  • With at least five (5) years of relevant professional experience in geothermal, thermal, industrial, or similarly complex operations
  • With at least two (2) years of leadership experience in a supervisory capacity

São Paulo, SP

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - São Paulo , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Disponibilidade de trabalhar presencialmente em São Paulo;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI).

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro).

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.

Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar!

About Topsort
At Topsort, we believe in the mission of democratizing the secret technologies of the walled gardens and creating a privacy-first cookie-free world of clean advertising with modern tech, friendly products, and AI. We believe in making advertising intuitive, intelligent, and genuinely cool, without any of the creepy ads or cookie-obsession (well, maybe just the chocolate ones). In a rapidly changing industry, we're on a mission to democratize monetization access for all and ensure that advertising doesn't leave any brand or seller feeling confused or overwhelmed
Today, Topsort has 5 major hubs worldwide, and employees in 13+ countries, including Menlo Park, Boston, Santiago Chile, Sao Paulo Brazil, Barcelona Spain, and Sydney Australia. We are a truly global company that was born in the pandemic that's had rapid growth since out of a genius product, a customer-first mentality, and a hardworking team of talented individuals. Since our founding in 2021, we've gained customers in retail, marketplaces, and delivery apps in 40+ countries and quickly approaching the #1 position in the industry.
Do you enjoy a fast-paced environment? Do you like seeing your work create real-time impact, being part of a rocket ship from the very beginning? Let's do the unimaginable - let's make ads clean and cool again, with AI and modern technology.
What it's like to work at Topsort
Our team is all about straightforward communication, embracing feedback without taking it personally, and fostering a super collaborative environment. It's a sports team that's hyper focused on winning, collaborative internally, and competitive externally - never the other way around.
We thrive on working in the open, lifting each other up, and getting things done with a sense of urgency. We're the kind of team that loves making bold choices, sharing extraordinary opinions, and maintaining a 100 mph pace. No endless meetings here – if it can be done today, we're all about getting it done today.
What is this role like?

We're looking for a highly skilled Project Manager with strong product instincts and deep technical expertise. In this role, you'll lead complex initiatives end-to-end—working closely with engineering and business teams to turn technical possibilities into real product value. You'll thrive in fast-paced environments and play a key role in shaping the future of our platform.

  • Project management of customer onboardings to ensure successful outcomes, driving customer growth and retention.
  • Collaborate with internal technical teams to train customers on using Topsort's platform and features effectively.
  • Setting KPIs and success metrics, ensuring full ROI for clients.
  • Ensure smooth transition to the Customer Success team by documenting client stakeholder roles.
  • Enhance the onboarding experience by improving processes and training materials.
  • Coordinate effectively with client agencies and third parties to achieve desired outcomes.
  • Collaborate with the development team to ensure custom development meets client expectations and standards.
  • Own the project, taking responsibility for successful implementation while working closely with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Facilitate exceptional user-enablement training and workshops to empower clients.
What (we think) you need to be successful - we're open to not checking all the boxes and be proven wrong by outlier candidates as well!
  • Minimum of 3 years experience in SaaS project management and client onboarding.
  • PM qualifications such as Agile, PMP.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal in English.
  • Demonstrated success in delivering projects in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Understanding of Webhooks and API.
  • Exposure to and understanding of AI-driven product recommendation tools and algorithms is a plus.
  • Experience with other CRM, ERP, or Marketing Automation platforms.
What We Value
At Topsort, we seek professionals who embody the following qualities to drive our mission forward:
  • Deep dive into details: Professionals who are not content with superficial answers and dive deeply into the details to uncover root causes and optimal solutions.
  • Team first: A low need for individual recognition, always prioritizing collective results over personal credit.
  • You thrive with ambiguity: Exceptional ability to tackle open-ended problems in unstructured environments, turning chaos into structured innovation.
  • Adaptability: Willingness to learn, mentor, lead, and follow as the situation demands, fostering growth at all levels.
  • Urgency: A disproportionate sense of urgency in execution, while keeping scalability and the creation of replicable processes in mind to ensure long-term success.
  • Curiosity: Genuinely curious individuals who can quickly learn difficult concepts and apply them effectively.

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Campinas , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Ter disponibilidade para trabalhar em modelo híbrido em Campinas;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.

Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

title: Data Platform Technology Lead
description:
Description

Serves as the leader for the Data Technology & Platforms team within the Health & Benefits technology organization. Focus of the role will be to lead data management & engineering function and collaborate with business and technology groups to provide data and analytics solutions and services that are aligned to the business strategy and needs.

Seeking a hands-on, data-driven, innovation-focused individual who will make a positive impact and maximizes opportunities for using data consistently and effectively to generate analytics and insights. Demonstrates an excellent understanding of current trends in the data sciences field and can leverage them to meet business needs.

The Role

  • Lead the team responsible for developing data strategy, data architecture, data engineering, and data integration for the line of business.
  • Provide vision and direction to the resources focusedon architecture, development and maintenance of data pipelines, operational databases and data lake infrastructures
  • Responsible for operational management of the data assets and pipelines to ensure datais accurate, complete, and timely.
  • Manage the documentation and metadata of the data assets and their representation within the Enterprise Data Catalog (Microsoft Purview)
  • Provide leadership to the team responsible for planning, building, and maintaining data and analytics capabilities to meet business needs.
  • Partner and collaborate with the line of business technology leaders, product owners and other business stakeholders to develop and implement data solutions and services and ensure alignment and effectiveness
  • Lead and develop the team, ensure effective day to day operations, change management, ensure deadlines, budgets and service levels are met, set objectives, define career paths, provide learning and development opportunities, conduct performance reviews, and continually improve results

Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in data management or related technology solutions area with at least 8 years’ experience in leadership roles.
  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Data Science, or related field is desirable.
  • Strong data engineering skills with focus towards Microsoft Azure cloud technologies including SQL, Fabric, Synapse, ADF, Python, Power BI
  • Experience of defining or working within data governance frameworks and associated technologies (e.g. Purview)
  • Candidate must have experience in data architecture, data management, or data science fields. Experience with BI and Analytics
  • Strong knowledge of data architecture, data integration, master data management, analytics, and their application to solve business needs/opportunities with ability to lead a team of highly skilled hands-on associates focused on collection, storage, management, quality, and protection of data for internal and external consumption
  • Expertise in evaluating both external and internal capabilities that are required to support the data solutions and services needs of WTW
  • The ideal candidate will have good interpersonal and communication skills, leadership qualities and be a team player
  • The following WTW competencies are essential for this role: Customer Focus, Problem Solving, Action Oriented, Results Focus, and Organizing & Planning

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation (Producer roles only).


Compensation

The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $170,000.00 -$200,000.00USD annually.
This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus.

Employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity.

This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until a sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified

Company Benefits

WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD&D, Group Legal, Identify Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)
  • Leave Benefits: Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off (includes state/local paid leave where required), Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, FMLA, ADA, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave),Paid Time Off (only included for Washington roles)
  • Retirement Benefits: Qualified contributory pension plan (if eligible) and 401(k) plan with annual nonelective company contribution. Non-qualified retirement plans available to senior level colleagues who satisfy the plans’ eligibility requirements.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

If the position allows for flexible working:

At WTW, we trust you to know your work and the people, tools and environment you need to be successful. The majority of our colleagues work in a ”hybrid” style, with a mix of remote, in-person and in-office interactions dependent on the needs of the team, role and clients. Our flexibility is rooted in trust and “hybrid” is not a one-size-fits-all solution.

We understand flexibility is key to supporting an inclusive and diverse workforce and so we encourage requests for all types of flexible working as well as location-based arrangements. Please speak to your recruiter to discuss more.

description:
We're quickly growing and super excited for you to join us!

About Topsort

Today, Topsort has 5 major hubs worldwide, and employees in 13+ countries, including Menlo Park, Boston, Santiago Chile, Sao Paulo Brazil, Barcelona Spain, and Sydney Australia. We are a truly global company that was born in the pandemic and has experienced rapid growth since our inception, driven by a genius product, a customer-first mentality, and a talented team. Since our founding in 2021, we’ve gained customers in retail, marketplaces, and delivery apps across 40+ countries, quickly approaching the industry’s #1 position.

Do you enjoy a fast-paced environment? Do you like seeing your work create real-time impact and being part of a rocket ship from the very beginning? Let’s make ads clean and cool again, with AI and modern technology.

What it’s like to work at Topsort

Our team values straightforward communication, embracing feedback without taking it personally, and fostering a highly collaborative environment. It’s like a sports team focused on winning, internally collaborative, and externally competitive — never the other way around.

We thrive on working openly, lifting each other up, and executing with urgency. We love making bold choices, sharing extraordinary opinions, and maintaining a fast pace. No endless meetings — if it can be done today, we do it today.

What is this role like?

We’re looking for a highly skilled Project Manager with strong product instincts and deep technical expertise. In this role, you’ll lead complex initiatives end-to-end, working closely with engineering and business teams to turn technical possibilities into real product value. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment and play a key role in shaping our platform’s future.

  • Manage customer onboardings to ensure successful outcomes, driving growth and retention.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to train customers on using Topsort’s platform and features effectively.
  • Set KPIs and success metrics, ensuring full ROI for clients.
  • Ensure smooth transition to Customer Success team by documenting client stakeholder roles.
  • Improve onboarding processes and training materials to enhance the experience.
  • Coordinate with client agencies and third parties to achieve desired outcomes.
  • Work with the development team to ensure custom development meets client expectations and standards.
  • Own the project, taking responsibility for successful implementation while working with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Facilitate user enablement training and workshops to empower clients.

What (we think) you need to be successful

We’re open to candidates who don’t check all boxes and are proven outliers!

  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in SaaS project management and client onboarding.
  • PM qualifications such as Agile, PMP.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, in English.
  • Proven success in delivering projects efficiently and on time.
  • Understanding of Webhooks and APIs.
  • Experience with AI-driven product recommendation tools and algorithms is a plus.
  • Experience with CRM, ERP, or Marketing Automation platforms.

What We Value

  • Deep dive into details : Professionals who thoroughly analyze to find root causes and solutions.
  • Team first : Prioritizing collective results over personal recognition.
  • Thriving with ambiguity : Turning chaos into structured innovation in unstructured environments.
  • Adaptability : Willingness to learn, mentor, lead, and follow as needed, fostering growth.
  • Urgency : Acting with a sense of urgency while building scalable, repeatable processes for long-term success.
  • Curiosity : Genuinely curious individuals who learn quickly and apply effectively.

Do you sound like the right fit? Let’s dive right in!

description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer, Growth - Contract

Join to apply for the Senior Full Stack Engineer, Growth - Contract role at Roofr

Senior Full Stack Engineer, Growth - Contract

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Senior Full Stack Engineer, Growth - Contract role at Roofr

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.
We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.
What You'll Get to Do:

  • Drive cross-product impact: Work across multiple product domains simultaneously—building experiments in Proposals, optimizing onboarding flows, and developing features that directly impact acquisition, monetization, and retention metrics
  • Move fast, responsibly: Operate in a Kanban environment where priorities shift based on experiment results and business needs, requiring you to balance rapid iteration with quality engineering practices
  • Own end-to-end user journeys: Build features that span the entire customer lifecycle—from signup and onboarding to subscription upgrades and hand-offs to implementation teams
  • Pioneer AI-driven experiences: Develop and iterate on novel AI-enhanced workflows and experiments that represent the cutting edge of roofing industry technology
  • Lead with autonomy: Work in a self-directed environment with our product designer and Growth EM, taking ownership of product decisions and driving features from conception to delivery
  • Build with experimentation in mind: Rapidly set up A/B tests and feature variations, prototype new experiences to drive user value, and help us learn and iterate on growth strategies with measurable business impact
  • Develop full-stack solutions: Build performant React components and work with Laravel backend following DDD patterns to create robust, scalable features that maintain code quality while enabling rapid experimentation
  • Make pragmatic trade-offs: Know when to optimize for speed vs. complexity, always considering the unique needs of cross-domain features and growth experimentation
  • Shape the future of roofing software: Join a small, passionate team where your individual contributions directly influence product direction and company growth trajectory
What You'll Bring to the Role:
  • Strong full-stack foundation: 5+ years of experience with JavaScript, React, and backend development (preferably OOP with Laravel/PHP), with 2+ years building scalable, multi-tenant SaaS products that serve real users
  • Database expertise: Strong PostgreSQL skills including query optimization, indexing strategies, and performance tuning for multi-tenant SaaS applications
  • Growth engineering mindset: Experience building for experimentation and metrics-driven iteration, with a track record of breaking down complex problems into testable proofs-of-concept and rapid experiments
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively with marketing, product, and design teams, consistently communicating technical tradeoffs to meet both user needs and business requirements
  • Autonomous problem-solving: You’re comfortable with ambiguity and scoping solutions independently, while knowing when to collaborate. You thrive in early-stage environments where priorities shift and individual ownership drives real impact
  • User-centered: You’ll have a deep belief that great products serve users while growing the business, with experience building accessible, reliable experiences that earn customer trust
  • A focus on quality: You value testing and documentation as much as code, and excel at making smart tradeoffs between complexity and speed to ship the right things quickly
  • Curiosity: A genuine motivation to move metrics and grow the business through thoughtful product decisions, not just technical execution
Bonus Points:
  • Direct experience on a growth team or working on acquisition/monetization initiatives
  • Data-driven mindset with curiosity about user analytics and behavioural patterns
  • An eye for visuals. Design skills aren’t required, but you can think critically about existing designs
  • Experience building AI workflows in production, or the curiosity to learn
  • Experience with A/B testing tools (Google Optimize, Optimizely, VWO, etc.)
What we offer (US + Canada)
When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:
️ Vacation/Paid Time Off:
  • 1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2!
  • 1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!)
  • Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years
  • Flexible time off
  • 80% employer paid benefits
  • RRSP/401k match
  • Generous Parental Leave policy
Perks:
  • We host 2 retreats per year and great team building activities
  • Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career
  • Home office setup stipend
  • Internet and phone allowance
  • Remote first culture
  • Weekly Friday paydays!
AI Notice
At Roofr, we’re big fans of AI. It helps us write job descriptions that don’t put you to sleep, takes notes during interviews so we can actually listen, and even helps us track down awesome humans like you.
Feel free to use AI to prep, research, or get pumped up for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT power users ). But when it’s time to chat, we’d love to meet you, not your AI alter ego. Bring your real, unfiltered self, we promise we will too.
And don’t worry, a real, live human is behind every part of our process. Every application is reviewed by a real person, and you’ll always speak with real humans throughout the interview process. No bots, just good people ️
️ Important Notice
We’ve been made aware of an individual impersonating Roofr using a fraudulent domain: roofrr.com (note the extra “r”). Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non-company email addresses, instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls.
 To ensure your application is legitimate, please apply directly through our official careers page: If you receive any suspicious messages or have questions, reach out to us at .
Your safety and security are important to us — thank you for your vigilance!

Overview:
The Senior DevOps Engineer plays a critical role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of Bunge's technology infrastructure. This individual will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and maintain DevOps processes and tools, and will be responsible for driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of Bunge's technology operations.

Essential Functions:
Lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of DevOps processes and tools, including CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and monitoring and alerting systems.
Collaborate with development teams to ensure that code is released frequently and reliably, and that deployments are smooth and efficient.
Work with infrastructure and cloud teams to ensure that the underlying infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and secure.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to identify and eliminate bottlenecks, reduce lead times, and improve the overall efficiency of Bunge's technology operations.

Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure issues and incidents in a timely manner.
Stay up-to-date on the latest DevOps trends and technologies, and share knowledge with the team.

Build partnerships, appropriately influence to gain commitment, foster talent and coach others to grow in current or future roles..
Drive results through high standards, focus on key priorities, organization, and preparing others for change.

Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field.
5+ years of experience in DevOps engineering.

Very good knowledge of English in general.

Solid experience with containerization such as Docker and orchestration tools such as Kubernetes.
Solid knowledge about security aspects in cloud and on-premise.
Proficient in scripting languages such as Python or Bash.

description:
We're looking for a talented and passionate Site Reliability Engineer, to join Wildlife's Cloud Platform team.

As an SRE you will have the goal to provide easy-to-use, highly available systems to all the engineers in the company. As an SRE of the Cloud Platform team, your main goal is to improve the infrastructure services, using and refining our existing automations, and contributing to building new services that will support the scalability and usability of the infrastructure services in the company.

We know that the work we do has a high impact on our company's success and culture. The right person for this position is curious by nature, proactive, loves solving problems, and can thrive in a fast and growing business.

What you'll do

  • Be part of a cross-functional team, directly contributing to feature development and maintenance of existing and new infrastructure services;
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize infrastructure clusters (Kubernetes, NATS, ETCD, Postgres, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, etc.) and infrastructure services (Gitlab, Jenkins, Vault, Artifactory, Datadog, Jaeger, etc.);
  • Manage the infrastructure required to run build pipelines on both Linux and macOS nodes in our cloud environment;
  • Define monitoring and observability patterns for infrastructure services;
  • Troubleshoot and manage incidents in production;
  • Manage and improve the tools and processes related to infrastructure management across the company (Infrastructure-as-code standards, CI/CD design, build of our Internal Developer Platform, etc.);
  • Help partner teams to architect and scale their applications and infrastructure with Cloud best practices.

What you'll need

  • Solid coding experience in at least one programming language. We work mostly with Go and Python;
  • University degree in courses related to computing such as Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, and Systems Analysis and Development or equivalent Market Experience;
  • Solid understanding of computer concepts (operational systems, networking, concurrency, memory management, and algorithm analysis);
  • Experience with cloud computing services such as Amazon AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure;
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code automations, such as Terraform, Packer, Ansible, Crossplane, etc;
  • Experience automating routine tasks, such as deployments and monitoring setup;
  • Experience with incident management and being oncall for productive systems and workloads;
  • Strong written and spoken communication skills in English;
  • Experience with complex, large-scale, and high-available systems;
  • Experience with monitoring and telemetry in applications and infrastructure;
  • History of technical leadership and ownership of critical projects, including the mentoring of junior team members;

Nice to have

  • Experience in building and automating mobile workloads and their technology (iOS, Android, Flutter, etc.).
  • Extra Bonus if related to gaming (e.g Unity, Godot).

More about you

Player focused. We are player-oriented, and infrastructure has a great impact on their experience. You have empathy with our players and focus on ensuring they have an amazing experience. You aim for a top-level infrastructure, guaranteeing the highest availability possible. Automation is key to scaling. We look for engineers who have a history of projecting and executing automation projects in order to get rid of any manual and repetitive tasks. Calm and pragmatism. When everything seems to be falling apart around you, you have a plan and keep calm. Bleeding edge. You are curious and like to study new technologies, test new solutions, and measure the impact brought by changes. We want to ensure we are using the best stack possible Metrics-oriented. We make decisions based on data and metrics. We measure the results of our tasks against the expected outcome. And we ensure our work has delivered the correct impact on our customers. We believe in ownership and in shipping features end to end. Bar raiser. You want to elevate your team skills and raise the bar, by mentoring your peers, spreading knowledge, being proactive and a tech lead.

About Wildlife

Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Today, we have offices in Brazil, Argentina, Ireland, and the United States. Here, we create games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come!

Atualizado em 22 jul 2025

O Programa de Microcrédito Produtivo do Governo do Estado (Ceará Credi), por meio do Instituto de Desenvolvimento do Ceará (IDT), está com inscrições abertas para interessados em atuar como Supervisor de Crédito em Sobral. As inscrições vão até sábado (26), e os candidatos passarão por seleção para duas vagas, sendo uma de ocupação imediata e outra para cadastro de reserva.

O candidato selecionado contará com benefícios como ajuda de custo para atendimento aos clientes, assistência médica conforme Norma de Gestão de Empregados, seguro de vida coletivo, auxílio alimentação, vale-transporte e remuneração variável por desempenho de até 30% do valor fixo.

Podem participar candidatos com ensino superior completo e disponibilidade para viagens. É desejável experiência em crédito, microcrédito, gerenciamento de pessoas e ações de apoio ao empreendedorismo.

As inscrições podem ser feitas até as 23h59 do dia 26 de julho de 2025. Para se inscrever, acesse o edital ( ), preencha a ficha de inscrição e envie cópias do RG, CPF, comprovante de endereço, comprovante de escolaridade e evidências de experiência profissional.

O Ceará Credi é um programa do Governo do Ceará, através da Secretaria do Trabalho, executado pela Agência de Desenvolvimento do Estado do Ceará (Adece), em parceria com o Instituto de Desenvolvimento do Trabalho (IDT). Atuar como Cientista de Dados em um ambiente em transformação, com foco inicial no desenvolvimento de um projeto estratégico de People Analytics . O profissional será responsável por aplicar modelagens descritivas e preditivas, atuar com soluções em nuvem (AWS/Sagemaker) e absorver entregas envolvendo modelos de linguagem (LLMs) , garantindo sustentação e evolução contínua.

Preferencialmente Híbrido – com base em Fortaleza/CE

Possibilidade de trabalho Remoto , com disponibilidade para viagens esporádicas

O primeiro desafio será liderar a frente de People Analytics , reposicionando o uso de dados na área de pessoas. A JDE Peet’s é uma empresa líder mundial especializada em cafés e chás, sediada na Holanda e com uma história que começou em 1753. Despertamos possibilidades de café e chá em mais de 100 países com um portfólio de mais de 50 marcas, incluindo L’OR, Peet’s, Jacobs, Senseo, Tassimo, Douwe Egberts, OldTown, Super, Pickwick e Moccona.

Como é trabalhar na JDE Peet's?

Somos pessoas unidas pelas possibilidades de café e chá. Na JDE Peet's, nós nos desenvolvemos com a liberdade de buscar oportunidades e de provocar novas ideias para causar um impacto positivo no mundo do café e do chá.
Nossa ambição é simples: despertar possibilidades de café e chá.
Colocamos em prática nossas intenções, cumprindo o que foi acordado e sempre levando as coisas adiante. Oferecemos aos nossos associados uma série de programas de aprendizado e desenvolvimento para apoiar seu crescimento pessoal.
Na JDE Peet's, acreditamos que é incrível o que acontece ao redor de uma xícara de café ou chá.

DESPERTE SUAS POSSIBILIDADES!

Descrição do emprego

Responsável pela gestão estratégica da categoria de manufatura externa, garantindo o atendimento às demandas de aquisição com foco em performance, inovação, compliance, sustentabilidade e otimização de custos. Atuação colaborativa com stakeholders locais e globais, promovendo parcerias sólidas com fornecedores e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento sustentável da cadeia de suprimentos.

Responsabilidades:

  • Atender às demandas de aquisições da categoria de Manufatura Externa;

  • Construir a equalização dos processos de concorrência com aplicação de ferramentas de análise que suportem a tomada de decisão;
  • Endereçar problemas de fornecimento junto aos stakeholders e fornecedores, atuando proativamente na mitigação de riscos e escalando potenciais necessidade de mudanças de estratégia de abastecimento à liderança;
  • Acompanhar o nível de serviço dos fornecedores (por meio de práticas de Supplier Relationship Management – SRM), performance dos KPIs JDE Peet's e termos e condições comerciais negociadas em contrato;

  • Identificar oportunidades de mitigação de custos e alavancagem de caixa, alinhado com o roadmap da categoria;
  • Garantir acuracidade na atualização dos indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e participação ativa nas governanças e fóruns de acompanhamento da categoria;
  • Liderar a construção do plano anual (AOP) e de Forecasts mensais, mapeando oportunidades e fomentando o pipeline de projetos de savings e melhorias;

  • Atuar como ponto focal da categoria em fóruns globais, promovendo alinhamentos estratégicos e garantindo a aderência ao Combined Business Model (CBM);
  • Assegurar conformidade com os controles internos, políticas de compliance e requisitos de auditorias internas e externas.

Superior completo em Engenharia, Administração, Economia, Logística, Marketing ou áreas correlatas;

Ampla experiência em Procurement;

Experiência em gestão de demandas em compras;

Experiência em RFXs e contratos;

Domínio de SAP e experiência com Ariba;

Experiência com Category Strategy e SRM;

Gestão de controles internos em Procurement;

Inglês Intermediário/avançado;

Espanhol (diferencial);

Nossa declaração de Diversidade Equidade & Inclusão

title: ESTAGIÁRIO(A) TÉCNICO(A) EM EDIFICAÇÕES
description:
Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 36 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos em todas as suas operações. Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: 71% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço.

A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais. Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui atualmente uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,86 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo (B3), Nova Iorque (NYSE) e Madri (Latibex).

Eletricista de manutenção para atuação na Aciaria, o qual irá realizar manutenção elétrica preventiva e corretiva visando maximizar a disponibilidade e desempenho dos equipamentos, garantindo a conservação das instalações, com um custo otimizado, e com a segurança de todos os envolvidos no processo de manutenção preventiva, corretiva, montagem e ajuste de equipamentos, gestão de peças sobressalentes e indicadores da área.

ESTÁGIO TÉCNICO EM EDIFICAÇÕES

Estamos com vagas abertas para estágio na área de Edificações na nossa área Técnica de Projetos para atuar na nossa unidade de Porto Alegre (RS).

A pessoa que ocupar a posição de Estágio Técnico em Edificações será responsável por:

  • Apoiar na recepção dos pedidos de aço cortado e dobrado, armado, arames e demais produtos do segmento da Construção Civil e analisar se as informações recebidas foram necessárias para incluí-lo no fluxo de programação dos pedidos, conforme os padrões da área;
  • Auxiliar na estima e análise dos pedidos de acordo com os requisitos solicitados (diâmetro, família, peso etc.), pelo cliente e atualizá-los nos sistemas de Gestão de pedidos;
  • Preencher planilhas e relatórios de controle, de acordo com a necessidade da área, visando fornecer informações sobre o desempenho das atividades realizadas aos superiores imediatos;
  • Planilhar projetos de diferentes tipos e complexidades de interpretação, ou seja, transferir dados dos projetos estruturais para o software de Corte e Dobra, seguindo os padrões de execução.

Qualificações e Requisitos:

  • Estar cursando Técnico em Edificações;
  • Ser maior de 18 anos;
  • Ter disponibilidade para estagiar manhã/tarde.

Se interessou? Veja a descrição da atividade e candidate-se até 30/08/2025.

O que oferecemos?

Programas de Benefícios da Gerdau

Na Gerdau, você é o personagem principal! Por isso, estamos sempre nos reinventando para construir o amanhã do seu lado. Valorizamos nossos colaboradores e oferecemos um pacote de benefícios abrangente para promover qualidade de vida e desenvolvimento profissional. Nossos benefícios incluem:

  • Assistência Médica: Cobertura de saúde adaptada ao Rol da ANS colaboradores e seus dependentes legais.
  • Acesso ao Pronto Atendimento Virtual e Atenção Primária Digital: Acesso sem custos a consultas médicas online, facilitando o cuidado com a saúde, ambos do Hospital Albert Einstein.
  • Vale-Refeição ou Refeitório: Vale-refeição ou acesso ao refeitório nas unidades da empresa.
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Programa +Cuidado: assistência profissional sem custo para apoiar na resolução de problemas pessoais: psicológicas, financeiras, jurídicas e sociais.
  • Gympass ou Totalpass
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale-Transporte ou Fretado: Auxílio no transporte diário ou opção de transporte fretado, dependendo da localidade.

O que desejamos?

  • Pessoas que tenham vontade de aprender, que sejam curiosas e tenham abertura para adquirir novos conhecimentos e habilidades.
  • Saber se expressar com clareza, tanto na fala quanto na escrita, e saber ouvir.
  • Gostar de trabalhar em equipe e ter disposição para colaborar, compartilhar ideias e aprender com os outros.
  • Ser responsável e estar comprometido com as tarefas e a entrega de resultados.

A EY é líder global em serviços de Auditoria, Impostos, Transações Corporativas e Consultoria. Dessa forma, exercemos um papel crítico na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor para nossos profissionais, nossos clientes e nossas comunidades.
Quase 35.000 profissionais especializados em atender a indústria financeira em todo o mundo, prestam serviços de auditoria, impostos, transações e assessoria empresarial para bancos, seguradoras e gestoras de patrimônio. Nas Américas, é a única organização de contabilidade pública com uma unidade de negócios dedicada a este mercado. A EY é líder em servir o mercado global de serviços financeiros.
O Financial Services Office hoje inclui mais de 4.000 profissionais em 50 localidades por todo EUA, Caribe e América Latina, com especializações que nos permite obter uma compreensão ampla das questões de negócios e dos desafios do setor financeiro, bem como oferecer serviços integrados para nossos clientes. No Brasil atuam junto aos principais centros mundiais para compartilhar conhecimento relacionado às tendências e regulamentações atuais e emergentes, a fim de ajudar nossos clientes a resolver questões fundamentais em gestão de riscos, controles internos, estratégia, operações e tecnologia da informação.
Este grupo de profissionais, dinâmico e talentoso, busca neste momento o candidato certo para integrar o time e desenvolver uma carreira sólida e ascendente.
Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.
Em Tech Financial Services (Tech FSO), estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando as necessidades e desafios tecnológicos dos nossos clientes do segmento financeiro (Mercado de Capitais, Bancos, Fintechs, Seguros e Gestão de Ativos). TechEY
Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?
Como Cientista de Dados Pleno você irá atuar em cliente de grande porte, com oportunidade de crescimento em frentes diversas na área de dados voltados para o segmento financeiro. Você poderá contar com ferramentas, conhecimentos e oportunidades para avançar e estar pronto/a para construir um mundo de negócios melhor para nossas pessoas, clientes e as comunidades que nos apoiam.
Poderá atuar diretamente com as tecnologias mais avançadas de IA Generativa e LLMs (como GPT, LLaMA e Mistral). Ambiente inovador, com forte incentivo à pesquisa aplicada e experimentação em IA. Terá oportunidade de participar do desenvolvimento de soluções reais e escaláveis. Cultura colaborativa e times multidisciplinares. Possibilidade de crescimento acelerado e envolvimento em projetos estratégicos de alto impacto.
Por que você?
Se você é apaixonado(a) por dados, colaboração e tem as seguintes qualificações, queremos você em nossa equipe:

  • Formação completa nas áreas de Tecnologia, Matemática, Estatística, Economia, Administração, Engenharias e ou correlatas;
  • Ampla experiência em Python, especialmente para aplicações de IA. Domínio de frameworks de LLMs (ex: Transformers, HuggingFace, LangChain, OpenAI API);
  • Proficiência com pipelines de dados, ETL, Apache NiFi, Apache Kafka. Prática com versionamento de código (ex: Git), testes automatizados e programação orientada a objetos;
  • Vivência com integração entre sistemas via APIs ou mensagens. Prompt engineering e fine-tuning de modelos;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado para leitura técnica e ferramentas.
Desejável - Ser ão considerados diferenciais:
  • Experiência prática em projetos de IA ou Data Science, preferencialmente em empresas do setor financeiro, como bancos e seguradoras, tecnologia, consultorias ou startups;
  • Atuação em ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) e participação em comunidades ou projetos open source de IA.
  • Familiaridade com publicações, artigos, ou apresentações em eventos de tecnologia.
  • Experiência prévia com validação humana de modelos (human-in-the-loop).
  • Certificações em Data Science (ex: IBM Data Science, AWS Certified Machine Learning, Google Professional Data Engineer), ou cursos reconhecidos em Machine Learning, IA ou Big Data.
Principais Responsabilidades:
  • Como Cientista de Dados você atuará na evolução de modelos baseados em LLMs, desde o prompt engineering até a implantação em produção;
  • Será responsável por criar, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados utilizando ferramentas de mercado (NiFi, Kafka);
  • Irá automatizar processos de ETL e integração entre sistemas;
  • Irá garantir a qualidade, versionamento e testabilidade das soluções desenvolvidas e atuar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares.
Oportunidade disponível em modelo presencial (com flexibilidade para o remoto) nos escritórios da EY Brasil.

Quem somos : Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

description:
O Grupo Casa do Adubo é capixaba e atua no mercado do agronegócio desde 1937. Atualmente, está presente em 11 estados brasileiros, oferecendo insumos e soluções para o setor agrícola.

Operamos em dois segmentos principais: Casa do Adubo , revenda de insumos agropecuários ao consumidor final, atendendo pequenos e médios produtores rurais através de uma equipe de vendedores externos e de nossas lojas, e Agrodistribuidor Casal , distribuidora atacadista que atende outras revendas de insumos no país.

Contamos com 35 unidades da Casa do Adubo e 10 equipes do Agrodistribuidor Casal, totalizando mais de 1.000 colaboradores que atendem agricultores e pecuaristas em unidades físicas e logística própria nos estados do Espírito Santo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Bahia, Mato Grosso, Rondônia, Acre, Pará, Maranhão e Tocantins.

Nossa expansão continua, e esses números estão sempre crescendo! \\o/

Valorizamos as pessoas e nossa missão é ajudar a realizar boas colheitas.

Se você não encontrou uma oportunidade que se encaixe perfeitamente no seu perfil ou interesses profissionais, não se preocupe. Criamos este canal "Banco de Talentos" para receber seu currículo, independentemente das vagas atualmente disponíveis.

Estamos construindo uma história de sucesso no mercado do agronegócio. Venha fazer parte dessa equipe apaixonada pelo setor!

A Casa do Adubo é sucessora da Irmão Chiabai, fundada em 16 de outubro de 1937 por Emílio, Ivo e Raymundo Chiabai em Afonso Cláudio, atuando inicialmente no comércio de secos e molhados, armarinhos, ferragens, tecidos e café. Em 1952, a sede foi transferida para Vitória-ES.

Em 1973, a empresa mudou sua razão social para Casa do Adubo Ltda para acompanhar o crescimento dos setores agrícola e pecuário. Sob a liderança de Estevão Covre e seus filhos Nicolau Emílio Covre e João Bosco Covre, os negócios receberam um novo direcionamento.

Na busca por expandir suas atividades rurais, a empresa inaugurou sua primeira filial em 1977, em Cariacica, onde fica sua administração central. Nesse mesmo ano, José Carlos Bento ingressou na sociedade.

Para consultar as vagas abertas e candidatar-se, acesse nosso novo portal de carreiras: Casa do Adubo.

Atualmente, o Hospital Vera Cruz conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 120 leitos de internação, 30 leitos de UTI, maternidade e pronto atendimento 24h. Além disso, oferece atendimento em mais de 66 especialidades médicas e possui Acreditação ONA 3, estando em processo de preparação para a certificação JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Hospital Vera Cruz, expandimos significativamente nossa rede em Campinas e região. Isso inclui a inauguração de novos serviços, como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia e a Unidade de Atenção Primária à Saúde, além da criação de unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba. Também adquirimos a Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais emblemáticos da cidade, instalado em um prédio centenário que faz parte do patrimônio particular local. No mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2care.

Essas aquisições reforçam as consolidações da nossa região, que fazem parte do grupo Hospital Care. Fundado em 2017, o Hospital Care nasceu da união de pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar no Brasil. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde, com um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, focado no equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Nosso sistema de saúde é completo, com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia, estamos presentes em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais de gestão de saúde, nos estados de São Paulo, Paraná e Santa Catarina. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos consolidar como a principal Rede de Prestadores de Serviços de Saúde do Brasil.
